notes: Checked against the archive's English licence and description pages for each database (BodyParts3D's Japanese licence page agrees). Both are CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use, each with its own credit line. The archive's Terms of Service (an English PDF, read but not quotable here) say each database's data follow the Creative Commons licence shown in its metadata, and forbid using researcher information from the service for advertising or other commercial activity, which a pinned picture or model doesn't involve. The library's pin command doesn't fetch from the archive, so a library item is written by hand. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
